Contract ManageProductCatalogCRUDService::createProductCatalog(id: Integer,name: String): Boolean {
	definition:
		catalog: ProductCatalog = ProductCatalog.allInstance()->any(o|o.Id = id),
		isExists: Boolean = catalog.oclIsUndefined() = false
	precondition:
		catalog.oclIsUndefined() = bool
	postcondition:
		let catalog: ProductCatalog in
		catalog.oclIsNew() and
		ProductCatalog.allInstance()->includes(catalog) and
		result = true
}
